trophies.howEarnedIntro: Achievements reflect actual hobby activity. Bronze, silver and gold unlock when their requirements are met. Achievements do not grant XP.
trophies.importPending: Import tracking is active for new imports. Legacy import medals cannot be verified without historical operation records.

seriesDescriptions.curator-of-wonders: Owned board games, RPGs, trading cards and miniatures count toward your collection. Wishlist items do not count.
seriesDescriptions.dimensional-wanderer: The four categories are board games, RPGs, trading cards and miniatures. Each category counts once when you own at least one item in it.
seriesDescriptions.fellowship-weaver: Only accepted GameTable friendships count. Pending or outgoing friend requests do not count.
seriesDescriptions.gathering-master: Events you organize count once they are marked completed. Upcoming and cancelled events do not count.
seriesDescriptions.stalwart-companion: Participation counts for completed events where you are recorded as attending. Signing up for a future event alone is not enough.
seriesDescriptions.manor-ascendant: Your Manor level comes from XP earned through hobby activities. Medals recognize milestones but do not themselves award XP.
seriesDescriptions.portal-keeper: The Grand Archivist rewards successful import operations across all four hobby categories. An operation counts once when it adds at least one new owned collection entry. Duplicate-only or wishlist-only imports do not count.
seriesDescriptions.tournament-champion: Win completed tournaments with an organizer-confirmed champion and recorded winning match.
seriesDescriptions.chronicler-of-legends: Participate in completed campaigns with at least one completed session.
seriesDescriptions.league-veteran: Participate in completed league seasons with at least one recorded completed match.
